changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition', 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_bak'; END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_bak] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_bak') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_bak', 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition'; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition') BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_FieldTypeFilteredLookupDefinition_FieldType] END END
